headline: Earnings and margins climb while cash cushion thins
summary_short: Apple reported diluted EPS of $2.02 (+28.7% y/y) on revenue of $109.42B (+16.4% y/y) and net income of $29.79B (+27.1% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue was $109.42B, up 16.4% y/y but down 1.6% q/q. Gross profit of $54.77B (+25.3% y/y) outpaced revenue growth, implying gross margin expansion from about 46.5% to 50.1% y/y. Diluted EPS was $2.02 (+28.7% y/y). Net income reached $29.79B (+27.1% y/y). Cash fell to $39.54B, down 13.2% q/q but up 9.0% y/y, while shareholders' equity rose 63.3% y/y to $107.52B.
